Every FILE blob equals the final postimage of its donor recipe-stage manifest (hash-pinned-java m3-intern-space -> snapshot -> chunk-byte -> chunk-long -> trie-scalar-core for M3InternSpace, path-trie -> trie-scalar-path for M3InternPathTrie, shapes, archive-guard; proofs and wrappers likewise); the retained variants pr15783 and pr15906 of M3InternSpace hold blob 59689ab1630d = the first-stage postimage 01baa19bf2f2 (older lineage), so the develop head is the newest complete lineage (README, Lineage).

# FILE rows: donor path (donor repository root) -> target path (module root m3/intern). PACKAGE: donor package -> target package. TYPE: donor type -> target type (identity: the donor names already carry the M3 prefix). EXTERNAL: a non-JDK package the relocated files import unchanged (JUnit 5, test scope). LITERAL: a declared string-literal token renamed as a whole token (the two Class.forName names of the private arenas in the chunk-match proof; jdk_naming.py rule PKG would otherwise rewrite them to jdk.internal.m3.common.intern and break the proof). CTOR: an explicit public no-argument constructor inserted after the declaration line of the named class (same access and empty body as the implicit one; -Xlint:all reports missing-explicit-ctor for the exported package and -Werror refuses). PIN: a token that must occur in the target exactly as often as in the donor (archive magics, versions and archived tuple kinds are never renamed). OMIT: donor files left out by decision (nothing copied; blob pinned).

owner-scoped append-only primitive intern space: ByteStore (atoms, blobs) over ByteArena (64-KiB byte pages), TupleStore (kind-separated long tuples) over LongArena (8,192-long pages), GraphStore (strict DAG nodes), page-bounded Arrays.mismatch collision verification, internString / internType / internPath / internFrozenInts, freeze, deterministic archive writeTo / readFrom (magic 0x4d334953 M3IS, version 1, bounded untrusted reads); package-private TupleStore.scopedMember for the trie

typed structural projections over one space: loader-scoped method signatures, ordered record layouts, frozen long[] blobs, canonical BitSet masks, lexicon-scoped token tuples (kinds M3MT M3RC M3LG M3MK M3TK)
prefix-sharing lexical path trie inside a space: (root, parent, atom, depth) tuples read through scopedMember, findExisting on a frozen space, isPrefix, commonPrefixLength

bounded SHA-256 container of the space archive (magic 0x4d334947 M3IG, version 1, 44-byte header): byte budget, record budget, allocation-free structural preflight (arity, forward DAG edges, trailing bytes) before the original reader

scalar-read trie proof main (46,617 checks recorded, normal and interpreter JVM)
